free_tier.stated: Signing up for the Free Trial creates a Free Trial billing account that is preloaded with $300 in free Welcome credit which is valid for 90 days.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: a tunnel or an address, not an object

retention.stated: not applicable: a live tunnel, not stored bytes

egress.terms: Network data transfer out to North America costs $0.12 per GiB from 1 GiB to 1,024 GiB, $0.11 per GiB from 1,024 GiB to 10,240 GiB and $0.08 per GiB above 10,240 GiB; the first 1 GiB each month is free; during the Free Trial period these prices are charged against the Free Trial credit amount.
egress.free_allowance: $300 in free Welcome credit which is valid for 90 days; the credit pays for the overage beyond the Free Tier limits

interface_detail: gcloud compute and the Compute Engine REST API
tooling: wg-quick on the VM; Google Cloud CLI for the instance and firewall rule
chaining: the origin half of a tunnel: run wg-quick here and the client connects straight to the public IPv4, with the 2.57 TiB credit as the entire budget

limits.value: $300 in free Welcome credit which is valid for 90 days; you are also limited to $300 worth of usage

binding_note: $300 in free Welcome credit which is valid for 90 days; the account is also limited to $300 worth of usage, and egress beyond the Free Tier limits is charged against the credit until it is spent or the 90 days pass

identity_cost.detail: During the sign up, you must provide a credit card or other payment method that is valid for the period of the Free Trial. Depending on your country, you might also need to verify your bank account.

reliability_note: a trial account that is not upgraded has its projects and resources stopped when the 90 days lapse or the credit is spent
confidence_note: Trial credit terms, validity periods and instance restrictions are documented in Google Cloud Free Trial terms.
